interface.longDescription: Eight strict Agent Skills plus one explicit-only host-extended Zhanggui orchestrator. /zhanggui owns WorkflowState and Embedded SkillRequest/SkillResult routing; eight zhanggui-* leaves stay discoverable Agent Skills with Direct and Zhanggui Embedded contracts. Activation order is native activation, catalog location, then controlled collection fallback.
defaultPrompt: 完整工作流先输入 /zhanggui，再直接描述目标；窄任务也可直接描述，由宿主匹配对应 leaf skill。
Type /zhanggui for the full workflow, or describe a narrow task and let the host match a leaf skill.
